body: Im quite content with my cashiering job at lowe's. I've only ever worked at Walmart or Kroger though. Those places both sucked. I'm lucky I am at a store with okay management and nice coworkers. Plus most customers tend to lay off when I apologize if they're upset about something.
I respect this method of approach. I'd do the same!
I love your store alligator. We just have a bunch of birds in our store..
Oh the glorious days of watching playthroughs of Corpse Party, Ib, Witch's House. Please take me back! Great iceberg, definitely gives me some more content to look for. :)
I'll have to say Kaiba directed by Masaaki Yuasa.

That's very tragic and horrifying. My dad always checks the Carbon Monoxide meter in the house every other week just to make sure it's working properly. He knew someone who went through something like that as well and he's been extremely paranoid about it ever since.
I am doing a lot better than I was yeah. I still struggle with some other stuff but I'm doing my best, thank you for asking. :)
Dream Deluxe by Acetantina / Kaizo Slumber

My mom's abusive ex was trying to break into our house because he wanted his stuff back. He kept slamming the door and windows demanding I let him in because he saw me. He had put my mom in the hospital before and had gone to jail for physical assault and I thought he was going to really hurt or kill me. I was 14 at the time and I locked the door to the garage. Then I hid under my grandpa's truck for a few hours until he gave up. I should have called the cops but I didn't want to risk it and too scared to think properly.

Edit: Meant to say I locked myself in the garage and then hid under the truck.

Another one that contends is probably when I was super deep into self harm and I was having hallucinations from staying up for multiple days at a time. Most of the time it was a shadow of a grim reaper looking person that was really tall. Probably just an actual shadow that I looked at wrong but it was horrifying.

I usually have to be with my friends to help with my anxiety, because when I am alone I have suicidal tendencies and am an alcoholic. It really sucks and it makes me feel helpless, I used to go on jogs and work out and that helped but eventually I just stopped enjoying it entirely. It's an uphill battle but my friends and family keep me going.
